# Scenario: soak. Campaign mission 1 "Arrival" (M202, Map01 City 1) reached
# through the seeded route (make-edf-save.py --mission 1 --armour 1000000:
# 1200200 stamina) so that 30 minutes of ant bites cannot end the run.
# Exercises: 30 minutes of gameplay for memory and renderer-cache growth and
# late stutters (tools/soak-report.py), with the view turning through every
# direction of the street, weapon switches and continuous effects.
# The player mostly fires above the ants (at the sky and the mothership, which
# the script cannot destroy) so the waves are not cleared quickly: a cleared
# mission would end gameplay on the result screen (soak-report reports any
# return to loading after gameplay started).
clock game
# Menu route with a seeded save (tools/make-edf-save.py via -SaveSeed; the
# runner tools/run-renderer-scenario.ps1 makes it). Times are game-clock ms from
# the first controller poll, like tools/native-benchmark-input.txt; the menus run
# at full speed, so they match wall time there.
#   20 s, 25 s  Start: logos / press-start screen (as the fresh routes).
#   30 s        A: title menu. With one occupied save slot its cursor opens on
#               Continue (sub_820C56A8 counts slots; notes/menu/0458).
#   35..60 s    A every 5 s: load screen (cursor on slot 1, no confirmation),
#               then headquarters "Start Mission", mission select (cursor opens
#               on the save's current mission), difficulty (Normal). That is four
#               presses; the other two cover one unexpected dialog (storage) and
#               otherwise land on the loading screen or the pre-mission scene,
#               where A does nothing harmful. The Technical controls never read A
#               on foot, so a late press cannot act in gameplay either.
# Check: renderer-runtime-gate.py --expect-mission <id> fails the run when the
# mission that loaded is not the seeded one (for example, if the title menu had
# opened on New Game the run would be the fresh Mission 1 route instead).
20000 1000 0010

60000 1000 1000

# binding-validation-20260923-012450-19f6e574 with the fresh route, whose menus
# end later than these; input before control is ignored) to 2100 s, two-minute
# cycles:
#   look up 25 degrees, fire while sweeping the sky and strafing (80 s),
#   one Stingray volley, look back down, 10 s of level fire down the street,
#   turn 100 degrees so each cycle faces a new part of the city.
